name: star-station
description: A read-aloud, choose-your-path picture book about a friendly space station. Offline, private, calm.

scripts.build: npm run check:story && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.narration: node tools/narration.ts jobs && tools/tts/.venv/bin/python tools/tts/render_narration.py && node tools/narration.ts manifest
scripts.verify: npm run verify:paths && npm run build && npm run verify:privacy && npm run verify:screens
